static_traits.name: 陈文迪
static_traits.social_status: 与队友的关系因自信not足与持续比较而紧张；拥有支持性的团队与教练，但难以就not足感与Self-doubt敞开心扉
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往类似心理问题与心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能具体描述问题与影响；倾向于useSelf-denial、比较与过滤正面表现的表述；Neutral attitude；语速与逻辑条理Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 我not断negate自己的成就，并因其他球员更为丰富的经验而感到not自足；这种not足与Self-doubt始于上赛季并持续到第二年，使我持续过滤掉积极表现、只关注错误或not足，Reinforcement了Self-doubt并影响赛场自信与表现。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些not足感和Self-doubt正在影响我的赛场表现并影响我的整体身心健康。
growth_experiences: 在职业联赛的第一个赛季（作为新人成员）开始承受“需要证明自己”的高压力；从那时起逐渐形成专注错误、过滤积极表现的模式，持续到第二年并显著影响赛场表现、自信、Interpersonal relationships以及睡眠与饮食。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/我能力not足

special_situations.event: 在比赛中发生失误（如关键进攻not yet达成或出现错误）
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我犯错，就证明I am not good enough，说明我without法跟上其他球员的水平
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles training, watches motivational videos, and frequently seeks coach feedback to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我就知道会这样；我跟not上其他人

special_situations.event: 在训练或与更有经验的球员互动时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人更有经验，我就注定not如他们、not属于这里
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在队友面前隐藏not安与Self-doubt，减少开放交流以避免暴露not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我像个局外人，我not属于这里

special_situations.event: 夜间回想当天的训练或比赛表现，反复思考错误导致Sleep affected
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 需要not断聚焦并纠正所有错误才能证明自己足够好；若not完美就是失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly reviews and harshly blames oneself, persistently focusing on negative details and ignoring positive performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我今天又搞砸了，我的表现全是问题

special_situations.event: 在一场比赛最后一分钟完成达阵后回顾该表现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果成功并非可复制或完美，就not算真正的能力
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate成功、将成就归因于运气，忽略积极反馈

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可与接纳，证明自己胜任并属于团队
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被评判，担心not被团队接纳、被看作not够格的局外人
defense_goal: 通过隐藏脆弱与加倍训练来避免暴露not足、维持安全感与自我价值

object_relations.self_representation: not够格的新人、容易失败的局外人
object_relations.object_representation: 经验更丰富、期待高且可能评判自己的队友与教练

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited or needing to express inner states and difficulties in front of the team/coach
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为暴露脆弱会被视为not专业或not够格，从而Being rejected或贬低
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use简短、含糊的回答，转向谈训练细节或任务；减少情感词汇，语气克制，避免过多自我暴露。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When achieving significant results and being affirmed by others (such as a last-minute touchdown)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将成功视为偶然或not具代表性，认为他人赞扬not可靠
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以“只是运气”“not算什么”等语句轻描淡写成功，语气淡化并迅速Displacement话题。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当在比赛或训练中发生错误并受到反馈或批评时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内心的not足感Projection为他人对自己能力的负面评价与not接纳
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Presets that the other party holds a negative view, belittles herself or apologizes in advance; responds with defensive statements, tone nervous, avoids eye contact.

manifestations: 在与队友互动时感到自己像局外人、觉得not属于团队
拥有支持系统却难以敞开心扉谈not足与Self-doubt
Interpersonal relationships因缺乏自信与比较而紧张
outcomes: 赛场Decreased self-confidence与表现受影响

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 以“必须证明自己”为内在准则承受高压力
将联赛与他人经验水平作为自我价值的硬性标准

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the original impulse to express outwardly or seek support, and acts on the self instead, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 隐藏not安与Self-doubt，not主动向队友或教练表达
将能量转为自我苛责与加练而非寻求情感支持

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection与过度自我限制、自我苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎，与“自主性”对应。
manifestations: 持续过滤积极表现、过度关注错误
在互动中预设自己not足，减少开放与自发性

exception_events.target_problem: 在比赛关键时刻，来访者通常会被Self-doubt与对错误的聚焦所困扰，导致紧张并出现更多失误。
exception_events.unique_outcome: Completed a touchdown in the last minute of a game, experiencing success and an exercise of ability at that time, with a result markedly better than the usual tension and mistakes.
exception_events.reason: 线索：当时可能将注意力聚焦在当下战术执行上，并获得团队配合与支持，因此出现了与平时not同的专注与发挥。

positive_force: Has the potential to deliver key performances under high-pressure situations (once scored a touchdown in the last minute)
愿意尝试新方法并接受咨询（开放度提高）
持续练习、主动寻求教练反馈（行动投入）
拥有支持性的团队与教练（外部支持）
negative_force: 持续比较并negate自我（自我价值依赖外部经验水平）
心理过滤与negate正面表现的认知模式
难以敞开心扉获取情感支持（人际回避）
赛后反刍错误导致Sleep and diet affected（生理与情绪失调）

target_behavior.behavior: 比赛与训练中出现高度紧张与Self-doubt，错误后反复反刍并Self-denial
antecedent: 在比赛或训练中出现失误
与更有经验的球员同场或互动
赛后Being alone时回顾当天表现
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自身价值与他人经验水平比较；形成“心理过滤”“negate正面”的认知模式导致对错误的灾难化与过度关注。
target_behavior.function: Escaping being evaluated and the sense of shame, trying to obtain a sense of control and safety through self-criticism and extra practice.
target_behavior.consequence: 赛场表现受损、与队友Relationship tension、Sleep and diet disturbance、整体身心健康受影响。
